# Two USD rates in CAD on 2026-02-02, three hours apart, in one file.
#
# GnuCash would keep only one of them, and which one would depend on the order
# of the file, so both are refused.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; two refusals.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_second_price_on_one_day_is_refused.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.36"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-02 15:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.37"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"
